text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Running is happy♪ Watching is happy♪ So I 
want to make everyone happy through my 
racing, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's celebrate this fresh 
start! Because the beginning is always 
important! Let's party!

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
